NewsArticle.Title: Monk Hubae Change
NewsArticle.Content:
The Monk 'Hubae requirements' have been decreased, making it easier for Monks to go up in Dugons. Below is the new breakdown:
White: 0 Hubae
Green: 0 Hubae
Blue: 4 Hubae
Yellow: 8 Hubae
Purple: 16 Hubae
Brown: 24 Hubae
Red: 40 Hubae
Black: 64 Hubae
Any Monks who had already reached Black Dugon through the old system will be granted the special title of Wisend Black Dugon.
